body:
Thanks! Tested with the provided MRPs and works as expected. The code also looks good to me, thanks to your explanation on [RC](https://chat.godotengine.org/channel/dotnet?msg=Xp4iEHuqQrtEbe38z):

> Passed in correctly at first, until rc->unreference that swap gchandle: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e1b4101e3460dd9c6ba0b7f8d88e9751b8383f5b/modules/mono/glue/runtime_interop.cpp#L197

I originally missed the call to `rc->unreference()` which causes the GCHandle to swap, and explains why `p_gchandle_to_free` becomes invalid in the middle of this function, even though we just retrieved it in:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e1b4101e3460dd9c6ba0b7f8d88e9751b8383f5b/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/GodotObject.base.cs#L124
